statement: Subpolynomial query complexity for log-concave sampling. For C2 potentials with a supplied minimizer and $`I\preceq\nabla^2V\preceq2I`$, proves that sampling within total variation 1/10 requires only $`C_\varepsilon d^\varepsilon`$ exact value-and-gradient queries for every fixed ε > 0. The bound holds on every run, with unrestricted computation between queries. A logarithmic lower bound also holds, so the optimal power-law exponent in this oracle model is zero.
